system.description:
Built on Project FU's Lightbearer.

EVANGELIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000297]{Moral Compass}

When another player character acts from cowardice, cruelty, fear, or despair, they earn 1 FP as normal. You may then choose to sour or strengthen your Bond with them — whichever is honest — as a cost or reward for being right.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000298]{Absolution} 【Max SL 2】

When a negative Bond emotion between two characters disappears after a genuine conversation, both characters earn 1 FP. You may spend 1 FP to trigger this once per scene if you facilitate the reconciliation.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000299]{Compassion} 【Max SL 3】

Spend (SL × 5) MP to fill one extra clock segment when you (or an ally you are helping) defuse an NPC's anger, grief, or shame through genuine conversation.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000300]{Righteous Fury} 【Max SL 5】

On a melee attack against a target with at least one dark-trait marker, spend up to 5 MP. Deal (MP spent × SL) bonus light damage.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000301]{Resolve} 【Max SL 5】

Reaction: when you or an adjacent ally would take damage from a target with at least one dark-trait marker, spend up to 10 MP. Reduce the damage by (MP spent × SL ÷ 2, rounded down).
